anchor_convention.basis: goblin body frames share position [-91,-152] => anchor at canvas (91,152), ground contact (position-space bottom of the sprite) +2..+25 px below the anchor across all untransformed body frames; the overturn frame shifts position to [-95,-97]. A fixed canvas anchor would place the 179.91-deg flipped body 127 px below the anchor (buried); the per-frame anchor keeps the overturned lying pose at +17 px, inside the standing range. Monster frames therefore carry a genuine per-frame anchor, unlike the characters' single fitted canvas anchor.
anchor_convention.evidence: verify monster_goblinthrower.json animations[*].frames[*].position; overturn note 'anchor shifted to [-95,-97] (flipped-on-back variant of body0#5)'
